sentences.text: Arjun Yadav @ Arun Yadav Son of Late Prabhu Yadav Resident of
Village - Babhandih, P.S.- Amas, District - Gaya.

Petitioner
 Versus
 1. The State of Bihar
 2. Sarvesh Kumar Singh Son of Chandrika Singh Resident of Village -
 Milkipur, P.S.- Rahui, District - Nalanda. At present - S.I., Vigilanc
 Investigation Bureau, Patna.

Opposite Pa  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Surendra Kumar Mishra, Advocate
For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ajay Mishra, Addl Public Prosecuto  ======

================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 23-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.
The petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 420,467,468,471/120B of the Indian Penal Code.
Prosecution case is that this petitioner in collusion with other accused persons got appointed teachers on the basis of forged and fabricated educational certificates.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
Decision of appointing teachers was collective decision of the selection committee and the same was not taken by the petitioner individually who was Mukhia at the relevant time.

There is no source to verify the authenticity of the education Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.73124 of 2022(2) dt.23-03-2023 certificates of the candidates by the selection committee.
Petitioner has got no criminal antecedent.
Learned counsel for the Vigilance opposes the prayer for bail.
